description:
Confirm a booking. Only call after the traveller has explicitly confirmed the hotel, dates, room,
        total price, cancellation policy and payment terms (set traveller_confirmed=true). Payment is
        collected by the property: never ask for card details. Returns the booking reference.

guest_email.description: Guest email; the confirmation is sent there.
guest_email.title: Guest Email

guest_name.description: Full name of the lead guest.
guest_name.title: Guest Name

guest_phone.description: Guest phone with country code, for the property.
guest_phone.title: Guest Phone

rate_key.description: rate_key from search_hotels or check_rate (valid 30 minutes).
rate_key.title: Rate Key

special_requests.description: Optional requests for the property (arrival time, cot…); not guaranteed.
special_requests.title: Special Requests

traveller_confirmed.description: true only after the traveller explicitly confirmed hotel, dates, room, total price, cancellation policy and payment terms.
traveller_confirmed.title: Traveller Confirmed

name: book_hotel
title: Book hotel
